name: Non-blocking runs and run control
description: FADE runs currently block the operator terminal, forcing multiple windows and causing human errors (wrong repo/window, accidental closure, loss of context). This PRD introduces detached/background runs with explicit run identity, live log streaming, and safe stop controls. This is foundational for long-running agentic workflows and is a prerequisite for dashboards and multi-repo operations.

userStories.title: Start a FADE run without blocking the terminal
userStories.description: Operators can start FADE runs in the background (detached) so they can continue working in the same terminal session—asking questions, inspecting state, or operating other repos—without spawning extra windows.
acceptanceCriteria: Command `fade run --detach` starts a run in the background and returns immediately with a `run_id`.
A run started with `--detach` continues running if the invoking shell session is closed (within reason for OS process handling).
Each run creates a folder `fade/runs/<run_id>/` containing at minimum: `run.json` (metadata), `run.log` (stdout/stderr), and `events.jsonl` (may be stubbed until FEAT-021).
Run metadata includes: repo path, repo name, branch, mode (STOP/ALL/YOLO), selected model, start time, and current PRD id/name.
If a detached run is already active for the same repo, FADE refuses to start another unless `--force` is used, and prints a clear message.

userStories.title: Observe and control active runs
userStories.description: Operators can list active runs, tail logs, and stop runs safely. This reduces window sprawl and operator errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Command `fade status` lists active runs and the last N recent runs with: `run_id`, repo, branch, state, current PRD, current story, model, and start time.
Command `fade logs <run_id>` prints recent log output; `fade logs -f <run_id>` tails the log until interrupted.
Command `fade stop <run_id>` stops a run gracefully (SIGTERM first, then SIGKILL only after timeout).
Stopping a run updates `run.json` state to `stopped` and records stop time and stop reason.
All commands print an execution header like: `FADE | repo=<name> | branch=<branch> | run=<run_id> | mode=<mode> | model=<model>` where applicable.

userStories.title: Prevent running commands in the wrong context
userStories.description: FADE should reduce human error by making context obvious and by providing safe defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: When a run is active for a repo, `fade run` without `--detach` warns the user and offers a clear suggestion (status/logs/stop).
Run IDs are unique, stable, and sortable (timestamp-based or incrementing).
All run artifacts remain inside `fade/` and do not pollute repo root.
